title: BNPL Gold: Credit Limits and Eligibility Explained
summary: This document explains BNPL Gold credit limits and eligibility: your credit limit is assigned within a stated range (values not available), is set during application review and may adjust based on account performance. It describes how available credit changes with plans and payments, eligibility requirements (customer segment and business registration—both values not available), and how to request a limit review after maintaining on-time payments; any limit change is communicated before taking effect.
